name: toolsmith
description: Observes Codex tool usage and helps improve project tooling over time.

interface.shortDescription: Logs tool usage and turns it into tool-improvement advice.
interface.longDescription: Captures Codex PreToolUse events into a local rolling corpus, then provides an analysis skill that identifies tool usage patterns, missing tools, AGENTS.md improvements, and practical software-engineering follow-ups.
defaultPrompt: Use toolsmith to analyze this project's tool usage and suggest improvements.
Run a tool blindspot analysis from the Toolsmith logs.
Use toolsmith to suggest AGENTS.md updates based on recent tool behavior.
